Mesh Msg

group SCHEDULER_MESH_MSG

Mesh message types for scheduler functions.

Defines

IS_SCHEDULER_INDEX_VALID(index) ((index) <= 15)

Macro to validate scheduler index.

SCHEDULER_EVERY_YEAR 0x64

Constant to schedule every year.

IS_SCHEDULER_YEAR_VALID(year) ((year) <= 0x64)

Macro to validate scheduler year.

SCHEDULER_IN_JANUARY (1 << 0)

Bitmask for scheduling actions in January.

SCHEDULER_IN_FEBRUARY (1 << 1)

Bitmask for scheduling actions in February.

SCHEDULER_IN_MARCH (1 << 2)

Bitmask for scheduling actions in March.

SCHEDULER_IN_APRIL (1 << 3)

Bitmask for scheduling actions in April.

SCHEDULER_IN_MAY (1 << 4)

Bitmask for scheduling actions in May.

SCHEDULER_IN_JUNE (1 << 5)

Bitmask for scheduling actions in June.

SCHEDULER_IN_JULY (1 << 6)

Bitmask for scheduling actions in July.

SCHEDULER_IN_AUGUST (1 << 7)

Bitmask for scheduling actions in August.

SCHEDULER_IN_SEPTEMBER (1 << 8)

Bitmask for scheduling actions in September.

SCHEDULER_IN_OCTOBER (1 << 9)

Bitmask for scheduling actions in October.

SCHEDULER_IN_NOVEMBER (1 << 10)

Bitmask for scheduling actions in November.

SCHEDULER_IN_DECEMBER (1 << 11)

Bitmask for scheduling actions in December.

SCHEDULER_EVERY_MONTH 0x0FFF

Constant for scheduling every month.

SCHEDULER_EVERY_DAY 0x00

Constant to schedule every day.

SCHEDULER_EVERY_HOUR 0x18

Constant to schedule every hour.

SCHEDULER_RANDOM_HOUR 0x19

Constant for random hour scheduling.

IS_SCHEDULER_HOUR_VALID(hour) ((hour) <= 0x19)

Macro to validate scheduler hour.

SCHEDULER_EVERY_MINUTE 0x3C

Constant to schedule every minute.

SCHEDULER_EVERY_15_MINUTE 0x3D

Constant for scheduling every 15 minutes.

SCHEDULER_EVERY_20_MINUTE 0x3E

Constant for scheduling every 20 minutes.

SCHEDULER_RADOM_MINUTE 0x3F

Constant for random minute scheduling.

SCHEDULER_EVERY_SECOND 0x3C

Constant to schedule every second.

SCHEDULER_EVERY_15_SECOND 0x3D

Constant for scheduling every 15 seconds.

SCHEDULER_EVERY_20_SECOND 0x3E

Constant for scheduling every 20 seconds.

SCHEDULER_RANDOM_SECOND 0x3F

Constant for random second scheduling.

SCHEDULER_ON_MONDAYS (1 << 0)

Bitmask for scheduling actions on Mondays.

SCHEDULER_ON_TUESDAYS (1 << 1)

Bitmask for scheduling actions on Tuesdays.

SCHEDULER_ON_WEDNESDAYS (1 << 2)

Bitmask for scheduling actions on Wednesdays.

SCHEDULER_ON_THURSDAYS (1 << 3)

Bitmask for scheduling actions on Thursdays.

SCHEDULER_ON_FRIDAYS (1 << 4)

Bitmask for scheduling actions on Fridays.

SCHEDULER_ON_SATURDAYS (1 << 5)

Bitmask for scheduling actions on Saturdays.

SCHEDULER_ON_SUNDAYS (1 << 6)

Bitmask for scheduling actions on Sundays.

SCHEDULER_TURN_OFF 0x00

Action to turn off device.

SCHEDULER_TURN_ON 0x01

Action to turn on device.

SCHEDULER_SCENE_RECALL 0x02

Action to recall a scene.

SCHEDULER_NO_ACTION 0x0F

Represents no action taken.

SCHEDULER_NO_SCENE 0x00

Represents no scene associated.

struct scheduler_register_t

Structure for scheduler register.

Public Members

uint64_t index

Scheduler index (0-15).

uint64_t year

Year field (0-99 or 0x64 for every year).

uint64_t month

Month bitmask field (bit 0-11).

uint64_t day

Day of the month (0-31).

uint64_t hour

Hour of the day (0-24).

uint64_t minute

Minute of the hour (0-59).

uint64_t second

Second of the minute (0-59).

uint64_t day_of_week

Day of the week bitmask (bit 0-6).

uint64_t action

Scheduler action (e.g., turn on/off).

uint64_t num_steps

Number of transition steps.

uint64_t step_resolution

Transition step resolution.

uint16_t scene_number

Scene number for recall action.
